text: Air traffic control cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain one one thousand, and the pilot monitoring read back one 1000 for Alaska 421. The crew set MCP 12000 and climbed, with the aircraft at 10920 at 58.1 s and then at 11880 at 64.5 s. Crosscheck said at 40.8 s "Cleared one-one thousand, set one-two thousand," which matched the recorded ground truth.
